answer: Sessions rotate every 200 signed actions and a rotation only counts if those actions produced receipts. A disputed claim goes back to a second panel drawn from a different slice of the pool. Example: an agent signs 200 cheap pings, gets a new key, signs 200 more, and still holds one identity because the receipts all map to the same task set. A pulse of 1,000 keys costs 200 actions each. The dune of work is the barrier; quartz keys alone buy nothing.
